observed_mac_boundary.evidence_source: 2026-09-12 generic browser attempt against the closed Hub handoff
observed_mac_boundary.temporary_profile_home_result: Profile-local HOME did not provide a distinct Chrome trust store; trusted Chrome logged Chromium net_error -202 (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID).
observed_mac_boundary.login_keychain_result: An untrusted Chrome control rejected the fresh certificate before import, then accepted it after the same certificate was added to the macOS login keychain for the trusted control.
observed_mac_boundary.conclusion: These macOS Chrome controls cannot make simultaneous trusted/untrusted certificate roots distinct by profile alone. The runner must not claim post-import untrusted isolation from this setup.

selected_correction.reason: Preserve real TLS rejection and real normal-TLS/CORS acceptance without weakening either check or requiring a new OS account in the minimal correction.

required_execution_order.name: untrusted_negative_before_import
actions: Create a fresh owner-only untrusted Chrome profile and CDP control with default macOS HOME and no supplied CA in the login keychain.
Capture its live Browser.getBrowserCommandLine arguments and reject any certificate-bypass flag.
Navigate only to the fresh Hub health URL and require ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID.
Record the negative result and close the untrusted Chrome control before any CA import.
forbidden: continue using the untrusted control after CA import

required_execution_order.name: trusted_positive_after_import
actions: Add only the fresh Hub certificate to the macOS login keychain with normal trust and record its exact certificate digest.
Export the exact imported certificate for witness comparison.
Create a fresh owner-only trusted Chrome profile and CDP control with default macOS HOME and no bypass flag.
Capture and bind its live command-line arguments to the owner-only witness.
Run the existing packed browser route against the fresh Hub endpoint with the exact origin http://localhost:4174.
required_checks: trusted normal TLS and Hub identity/discovery/readiness
at least one successful Hub CORS preflight from the exact local origin
fresh credential use, nonempty vehicles, current state and five drives over 2/2/1 pages
credential rotation and following default Fetch vehicles request
trusted browser, helper server and Hub cleanup

runner_contract_change.change: Add an explicit sequential trust mode. Perform the untrusted health rejection and witness capture before the CA-import hook, close that control, then perform CA import and run the trusted route. Do not run the current post-import untrusted navigation in this mode. Keep the existing simultaneous path for legacy witnesses.

hook_contract.command_encoding: Each hook environment value is a JSON argv array. The runner appends one JSON payload argument and invokes the executable with shell=false.
hook_contract.import_result: The import hook must return observed=true, the exact fresh certificate fingerprint, certificateExportPath equal to the independent canonical TESLATLAS_BROWSER_EXPECTED_CERTIFICATE_EXPORT_PATH, trustStorePath and trustedCdpUrl matching TESLATLAS_BROWSER_CDP_URL. The expected export path must be absent before import and owner-only regular after import.
hook_contract.trusted_browser_cleanup_result: The trusted-browser cleanup hook receives the fresh endpoint, exact certificate fingerprint and expected trusted CDP URL. It must report observed=true, the same endpoint and certificateSha256, closed=true and portClosed=true, even when import output is malformed or CDP attachment fails.
hook_contract.cleanup_payloads: Remove and verify-removal hooks receive the exact imported fingerprint and must report observed=true; verify-removal must report present=false.

requirements: Both live argument arrays are captured from CDP and contain no bypass flag.
The trusted exported CA digest equals the fresh Hub certificate digest.
The witness records phase order; it must not relabel the pre-import negative control as a post-import negative control.

receipt.limits: The receipt proves sequential negative-before-trust and positive-after-trust behavior on macOS. It does not prove simultaneous per-profile trust isolation.

fresh_required: new Hub runtime root and loopback endpoint
independent canonical expected certificate export path, absent before import
closed_inputs: all prior browser profiles and witnesses
fresh_handoff_contract.handoff_must_state: The sequential mode is reviewed and the Hub understands that the untrusted control is closed before CA import; no simultaneous trust-isolation claim is admitted.

sdk_owner: Close the untrusted control immediately after the pre-import rejection.
Close the trusted control and local helper server after the redacted receipt.
Invoke the trusted-browser cleanup hook after import starts, including malformed import output or failed CDP attachment; require its exact endpoint/port-closure result.
Remove the exact fresh certificate and its user trust setting from the login keychain.
Remove fresh browser profiles, witness/export artifacts and package installation state, retaining only the mode-0600 redacted receipt.
Verify 4174 and all CDP ports are closed without touching unrelated processes or services.
hub_owner: Stop only the fresh fixture launcher and direct Hub child after the SDK result or expiry.
Verify direct-child exit 0, stopped receipt mode 0600 and loopback port closure.
cleanup_contract.secret_policy: Credential, invitation, keychain password, private key and browser-profile contents remain outside the repository and chat.

approval_gate.before_source_change: Coordinator authorized this bounded source correction after reviewing the proposal; Hub review of the implemented diff remains required before runtime.
approval_gate.before_runtime: Hub has substantively reviewed the source correction and must publish a wholly fresh handoff matching the reviewed sequential mode. The current 18521 tuple is not reusable.
approval_gate.attempt_limit: One bounded fresh execution only unless the owner explicitly changes scope.
